findings.note: SB 1174 (2024), Elections: voter identification. The bill bars local governments from requiring voter ID or similar identification to vote. Vote taken from the Internet Archive copy of the California Legislature vote page.

AB 1116 (2025), Elections: voter registration. The bill lets a person without a California driver license or state ID register online using the last four digits of their Social Security number plus an electronic signature image. This is the Senate floor vote as listed on the CalMatters Digital Democracy bill page; the page lists a Senate Floor hearing of Aug 24, 2026 but gives no vote date, so only the month is recorded.
